scope: Dimensioned engineering design drawings and IFC export; fabrication and IFC import deferred.

definitions.Extract existing: Information is present but requires normalization or physical interpretation. Not a request for new engineering data.
definitions.Resolve mapping: Source records need a reviewed association to physical elements, joints, stories or zones.
definitions.Verify geometry: A required detail parameter was not established by the stated inspection. Check linked sources before treating it as absent.
definitions.Supplement required: Reviewed evidence identifies additional drawing data or a placement decision that must be supplied.
definitions.Supplier / delegated: Source scope depends on external engineering or supplier data. Retain its boundary or supply that package.
definitions.Scope decision: Choose which explicitly excluded/context parts are represented and at what level.
definitions.Verify source: Provenance or source applicability needs confirmation.
definitions.Drawing decision: Presentation or drawing conventions need a documented choice.

limitations: This audit assesses source data availability, not structural adequacy or construction readiness.
No cfg.py, solver, design engine or generated Python model was executed.
All 61 packages were inventoried; every connections[] row and selected CFS drawing-related tables were indexed. This is not exhaustive numerical reconstruction.
Script geometry was inspected as syntax and literal calls. No-splice notes retain their other joint references and must not be discarded as whole-record exclusions.
Geometry word screens show only whether language was found in a record. They are not numerical parsing or proof of sufficiency.
Referenced schedules and prose can contain additional values. Verify-geometry items are not confirmed package-wide absences.
Register affected-record lists and evidence locators define scope. Blank affected-record lists mean a building-level requirement.
Existing consistency PASS results are reported, not recomputed, and do not test drawing geometry.
Current repository inspection revisions are not claimed to be the revisions that produced the supplied packages.
Counts are source records, including typical groups and exclusions; additional schedule records can describe the same physical system.
